svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 138 mm of 20 x 6 mm flat bar; round both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pivot hole 8.2 mm, 20 mm from the bottom end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cable hole 5 mm, 6 mm from the bottom end: 13.8 mm below

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The pull rod's tail pushes the lever's face 106 mm above the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pivot, so the cable end moves 7.7 times less and pulls 7.7

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: between the housing's cheeks on an M8 bolt with two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: spring washers each side, set so the lever swings with a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: light drag (this is the coupler's damping).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: At rest the rod's tail is 2 mm short of the lever.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the lever swings freely through 30 degrees.
